verdict.rationale: Viam documents a uniform component API, so swapping hardware in config does not require code changes (viam-docs-19, viam-docs-41). However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions a simulator, simulated or fake components, or any simulation backend that robot code could run against. The hardware abstraction is a prerequisite for sim-to-real portability, but there is no evidence that Viam delivers the simulation side of this story.
